title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f9v whole-reading robustness across the three transcriptions
summary: A candidate full-entry interpretation should specify in advance how its content-bearing spans map to ZL3b, IT2a and RF1b, which are alternate readings of the same manuscript. Audit segment-sensitive claims and state whether each survives or becomes indeterminate under actual disagreements. This checks dependence on a chosen transcription, not a semantic confirmation or three independent witnesses.

design.mechanism: alternate-transcription sensitivity of a whole reading
design.unit: content-bearing span in a complete f9v reading
design.contrast: invariant span predictions versus segmentation-dependent predictions
design.prediction: claims requiring one disputed segmentation are flagged as conditional rather than counted as independently replicated
